correctness.rationale: Cross-divisibility analysis is exhaustive for p<q. Fixed-p PNT(AP) yields exact term x/[p(p-1)log x]. Uniform BT bounds p<=x^1/4 tails by 4x/logx sum_{p>Y}1/[p(p-1)]; trivial progression bound gives O(x^3/4+sqrt x)=o(x/logx) for larger p. Letting Y grow proves the convergent constant. Finite counts and rational tail bound independently checked by verify.py.

originality.rationale: Exact prime-series leading constant is absent from the closest published squarefree-semiprime result, whose full RESULT.md explicitly asserts only O(x/log x). The stronger exact asymptotic is neither implied by that bound nor by Pollack's general-integer inequalities. The examined 1983 survey and OEIS data do not count this thin exceptional stratum asymptotically. Original 1979 Duffy and Luca 2007 whole texts remain unresolved access risks, explicitly disclosed.
residual_risks: Equivalent exact constant in unlocated arithmetic-density literature is possible.
Duffy 1979 original article was not available for complete inspection; exact day of its publication is unknown.
Luca 2007 article was identified through open catalogues but full original text was not accessed; an institutional downloader attempt was blocked by access controls and not bypassed.
OEIS A003624 first exactly dated available record is 1994-09-19, although the 1979 article is older in year-only bibliographies.

value.rationale: Provides an exact positive first-order constant for a natural exceptional stratum of size x/log x. Previous literature had only an upper order bound and the local criterion. The constant is sensitive to every fixed odd prime and distinguishes parity contribution, enabling precise statistical predictions for non-Duffinian semiprimes. This is a motivated natural invariant, not a parameter-picked finite census.
